Main Content with Sidebar

This layout demonstrates the use of <aside> for sidebar content and <figure> for media with captions.

The aside element represents content that is tangentially related to the main content. This could be sidebars, call-out boxes, or related links.

"The best way to predict the future is to invent it."

— Alan Kay

Using semantic elements like figure and figcaption provides better accessibility and structure for media content.
